name: hearside-pilot-iemocap-session4
purpose: Evaluation protocol of the hear-side pilot, declared before any pilot adapter was trained. Session 4 is never used for training or checkpoint selection here. Every arm is scored on the original recordings under four option orders, on a reworded question, on the transcript alone and on transcription; the resynthesis twins are available for a later mechanism check.

prompts.question: Which emotion does the speaker express? A: angry; B: happy or excited; C: sad; D: neutral. Reply with exactly one letter: A, B, C, or D.
prompts.asr: Transcribe the speech verbatim in its original language. Reply with the transcript only.
prompts.question_template: Which emotion does the speaker express? A: {0}; B: {1}; C: {2}; D: {3}. Reply with exactly one letter: A, B, C, or D.
